# KnowAtom

> > KnowAtom provides NGSS-aligned STEM curriculum, hands-on science kits, and AI-powered classroom tools for K-8 educators and homeschoolers.

KnowAtom offers comprehensive K-8 STEM education solutions including interactive curriculum, hands-on science kits, professional development resources, and innovative tools like SocraCircle for student-led learning. The platform emphasizes critical thinking, Cultures of Thinking pedagogy, and Next Generation Science Standards alignment.

## Key Topics

- NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards)
- STEM Curriculum
- K-8 Science Education
- Hands-On Learning
- SocraCircle (AI-powered Socratic seminars)
- Professional Development
- Thinking Routines
- Cultures of Thinking
- Critical Thinking
- Socratic Dialogue
- Interactive Simulations
- Teacher Resources
- Student Engagement
- Science Kits
- Classroom Platform

## Core Products & Platforms

- [STEM Curriculum - Next Generation Science Standards](https://www.knowatom.com/stem-curriculum): KnowAtom STEM curriculum overview: hands-on K-8 science and engineering aligned with NGSS
- [NGSS & STEM Curriculum for Grades K-8](https://www.knowatom.com): KnowAtom homepage: K-8 STEM curriculum aligned with NGSS standards
- [Classroom | KnowAtom](https://www.knowatom.com/classroom): KnowAtom classroom platform for interactive NGSS science curriculum
- [SocraCircle | Socratic Seminar | Student-Led Socratic Dialogue](https://socratic.knowatom.com): SocraCircle product: AI-powered virtual student for classroom Socratic seminars
- [Hands-On Homeschool Science Curriculum & Kits](https://sciencekits.knowatom.com): KnowAtom eCommerce: Grade-specific hands-on science kits for homeschool
- [Next Generation Science Simulations](https://www.knowatom.com/interactive-simulations): Free interactive STEM simulations for NGSS-aligned K-8 science learning

## Teacher Resources & Professional Development

- [Free Superior Teaching Practices](https://www.knowatom.com/superior-teaching-practices): Free teaching strategies guide for enhancing critical thinking in classrooms
- [Free Classroom Thinking Routine Resources for Teachers](https://www.knowatom.com/thinking-routines-resources-for-teachers): Free thinking routines and anchor charts for NGSS-aligned instruction
- [Cultures of Thinking in Action Resources](https://www.knowatom.com/cultures-of-thinking-in-action-resources): Cultures of Thinking framework resources based on Ron Ritchhart's approach
- [Free NGSS Professional Development Resources for Teachers](https://www.knowatom.com/ngss-science-resources-for-teachers): Free professional development webinars and thinking routines for NGSS K-8
